So they want CSS code for a card that rotates when hovered. We need to provide HTML and CSS. They didn't ask for JavaScript. Just CSS. Provide a simple card with transform: rotateY(180deg) or rotateX. Use transition. Provide example. Also maybe mention perspective. Provide code snippet. Should we include explanation? Probably yes. Provide minimal example. Also mention that the card can have front and back. Provide container with perspective. Provide card with transform-style: preserve-3d. Provide front/back faces. Provide hover effect. Provide CSS. Provide HTML. Provide explanation. That should satisfy.
